subject.title: bug(agents): nodes tool describe action fails with 'node required' due to schema/implementation mismatch

question: What should the agent-facing `nodes` tool return when `action: "describe"` omits `node`?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the issue discussion and linked PR differ on whether omitted `node` should select a default/current node or return discovery/list output, which changes multi-node agent behavior.

options.title: Default-node describe
options.body: Approve the linked PR shape or a replacement that makes only read-only `describe` use the existing default-node resolver, with regression coverage.

options.title: Discovery describe
options.body: Define omitted-node `describe` as list-style discovery output, which may be clearer for multi-node agents but is a broader output-contract change.

options.title: Require explicit node
options.body: Make the schema/help require `node` for `describe`, preserving current runtime behavior but removing the discovery affordance that triggered the report.

recommendation.title: Default-node describe
recommendation.body: Approve the linked PR shape or a replacement that makes only read-only `describe` use the existing default-node resolver, with regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` is the clearest history owner for the flattened schema and default-node resolver paths involved in the decision.
